Conley & Stephenson Law Group
Baytown, TX
Phone 281-555-9622
Settlement Demand
May 19, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1188 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client, Vincent Bryant, regarding the collision that
occurred on February 11, 2024. Our client was traveling in their lane when the other
vehicle crossed the center line and struck head-on at low speed. The impact was not
minor in its effect: our client was thrown forward and back against the seat, and was
left with a neck strain that has required ongoing treatment, including physical
therapy and restrcited range of motion that has interfered with daily work and sleep.
The liability picture is straightforward. Your insured left the proper lane without
warning, and the responding officer's report documents the position of both vehicles
at rest. There is no reasonable basis on which to attribute fault to our client.
Our client has provided all treatment records and billing statements requested to
date. The medical documentation links the complaints directly to the collision, and
the treating providers have noted no prior history of similar symptoms.
On behalf of our client, we demand payment of $200,000.00 to resolve all claims arising
from this loss. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this
letter. If we do not receive a substantive response within that period, we will file
suit without further notice and seek all damages available under law.
Expert review: Jennifer Miles, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Colleen Orr
Conley & Stephenson Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
